sources.title: Swissmedic — Advertising of therapeutic products (guidance hub)
Therapeutic Products Act (TPA / HMG) — advertising framework

medical.title: Consistent with Swiss information for healthcare professionals
medical.check_prompt: Flag claims inconsistent with the supplied Swiss Fachinformation / product information. Missing → [GAP].

medical.title: Balanced presentation
medical.check_prompt: Flag benefit claims that omit material risks present in supplied Swiss product information.

legal.title: Public advertising restrictions for Rx
legal.check_prompt: Flag prescription medicine advertising aimed at the public. Confirm HCP-directed placement.

regulatory.title: Swissmedic advertising rules for the format
regulatory.check_prompt: Check format-specific Swissmedic advertising expectations against supplied materials. Unknown format → [GAP].

regulatory.title: Pharma Code company obligations
regulatory.check_prompt: Note that Pharma Code certification/approval is a company process. Packet prepares reviewers; it does not certify.
